description.value: Golden Carriage Restaurant is a Chinese restaurant on 5th Street in Courtenay, BC, serving the Comox Valley. It offers online ordering with in-store pickup and local delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through downtown Courtenay. The restaurant appears to be a well-established neighbourhood spot with a broad menu of Chinese cuisine.
